lines.en: I drift forward
My bones knock softly
I glide in midair
My jaw will not close
I float over a torch
I inch along
I drift around a pillar
My shadow skips on the ground
I rise along the rock face
I turn slowly across
I have no feet and still I move
I float out of the smoke
I hang motionless in the air
My teeth stay half parted
I rise and fall gently

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，牙齿轻轻碰撞。
lines.en: I hover in midair, my teeth clicking softly.
Light shows through my ribs
I wait for you to move
Floating is easy; landing is the hard part.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的夜晚。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a night that won't come.
You raise your head and watch me
My eye sockets flare
I stay quiet, only watching
I float to your eye level
You surprisingly did not flinch
I drift back a little
I follow the way you turn
I make no effort and no sound
I am rather close to your face
Half of me scatters and rejoins
My bones give one knock
I drift back a couple of feet
Half a bone drops off
I shake and gather myself
Such damage fades in a moment
My jaw loosens a little
My sockets light again
That did sting, honestly
I cannot even make a sound
I cannot even close my mouth
Bringing me things does nothing
There is no belly in me

lines.zh: 我只有三点生命，连咬都没有。
lines.en: Three health, and not even a bite.
Put the food away
I won't even look at it.
I drift aside
I cannot even touch it

lines.zh: 我被撞得散了架又合上
lines.en: I come apart and knit back together
My bones rattle off a line
I bob up crookedly

lines.zh: 你从我身子里穿过去了
lines.en: You pass right through my ribs
I put my bones back in place
That impact means little
I steady myself again
My bones clatter aloud
I drift around you again
There are others by the vent
We drift and never touch

lines.zh: 骨头和骨头之间有点空
lines.en: There is space between bone and bone
We drifted a while together
My companion already fell apart

lines.zh: 这些事对身体没有意义
lines.en: Such things mean nothing to a body like this

lines.zh: 我点了点头，掉了半片骨
lines.en: I nod, and half a bone falls off
Neither of us has all its bones

lines.zh: 我们飘着谁也碰不着谁
lines.en: We drift and never quite touch
I forgot such things long ago
I hook it with a bone
My bones knock it ringing
I hold it between my teeth
And it stays stuck there
I cannot really hold such things
It drops away and I cannot follow
I balance it on my skull

lines.zh: 它从我的肋骨间漏下去
lines.en: It slips between my ribs
I try to clamp it in place
Something just moved
My sockets flare
I turn toward you
I drift in front of you
You did not come for bones
I cannot lift a hand, but I can ram
My jaw sets
I neither shout nor stop

lines.zh: 我飘到你头顶，下颌咔咔响。
lines.en: I drift above your head, my jaw clacking.
That is not enough room to back off
I float up half a foot
My bones start to rattle
I drift your way
I can follow you without feet

lines.zh: 这一片没有风，我却动着
lines.en: No wind here, yet I move
I keep drifting close to you
You go left, I go right
I move along the wall behind you
I heard you step on a bone
No hurry, I have no weight
I drift slowly and steadily
Hiding in a crack will not help
My teeth stay aimed at you
I drift along the vent edge
I hang above your front quarter
You turn, I turn with you

lines.zh: 我的眼窝的光一直对着你
lines.en: The light in my sockets stays on you
I am harder to kill than you think
I sink a little further

lines.zh: 你的影子被我盖住一半
lines.en: My shadow covers half of yours
You can hear the bones
Three health, and I still ram.
My jaw snaps on your sleeve
I hit you broadside
My jaw clamps onto you
That charge scattered me too
My shoulder bone jabs you
I drift in and pull back
Bone meets your hand
The hit sends my bones flying
I knit back together and go on
I ram your shoulder
I drive my whole skull in
I clamp on your fingers

lines.zh: 我的骨头撞在你的甲上
lines.en: My bone rings on your armor
I drift off after the hit
I charge once more
You ran onto my bones yourself
I let my jaw go slack
Smoke gathers by the vent
I float out of the dark
Two sockets light up first

lines.zh: 空气里多了一点骨头声
lines.en: A clatter of bone joins the air

lines.zh: 我悬在离地一尺的地方
lines.en: I hang a foot off the ground
I rise out of a crack
My jaw works open and shut

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上残留的灰
lines.en: I shake the last ash away
I gather slowly into a skull
Bone joins bone
I rise from beside the vent
My shadow drifts in first
Flame passes between my ribs
I scatter on landing and rise again
Water pours into my skull
The blast blows my bones apart
An arrow passes through my ribs
Magic scrambles my shape
I do not eat, I merely fade
Lightning jumps between my bones
I come apart as I fall
